# HiP Paris

> > HiP Paris is a curated lifestyle and travel blog focused on discovering authentic Paris experiences, from hidden bistros and concept stores to neighborhood guides and French craftsmanship.

Founded by Elena Berton, HiP Paris (Haven In Paris) offers insider perspectives on Parisian culture, dining, shopping, and sustainable living. The blog extends beyond Paris to cover French regions like Provence and Brittany, plus select European destinations like Venice, with an emphasis on art de vivre and local expertise.

## Key Topics

- Paris neighborhoods (Canal Saint-Martin, Montmartre, SOPI)
- French cuisine and bistros
- Restaurant reviews and chef profiles
- Concept stores and French craftsmanship
- Paris shopping and fashion
- Zero waste and sustainable living
- Weekend travel itineraries
- Gluten-free dining in Paris
- Cooking classes and market tours
- Art museums and Venice Biennale
- Philippe Starck and French design
- Michelin-star chef recipes
- Expat resources and practical guides
- French menswear and accessories
- Provence hilltop villages

## Paris Neighborhood Guides

- [Things to do in Canal Saint-Martin in Paris, France](https://hipparis.com/where-to-go-in-paris-canal-saint-martin-neighborhood): Canal Saint-Martin neighborhood guide: vintage shops, bistros & attractions
- [The Other Side of Montmartre: The Best Restaurants, Bars & Cafés North of Sacre Coeur](https://hipparis.com/the-other-side-of-montmartre-the-best-restaurants-bars-cafes-north-of-sacre-coeur): Jules Joffrin neighborhood guide: best dining north of Sacre Coeur

## Paris Dining & Food Culture

- [French Michelin-Star Chef Recipes for a tasty Lockdown feasts](https://hipparis.com/french-michelin-star-chef-recipes-for-lockdown-eric-frechons-scrumptious-ham-and-cheese-croque-monsieur): Michelin chef Eric Frechon's croque monsieur & lockdown recipe collection
- [Gluten-Free in Paris Part 1: Paris' Best Gluten-Free Bakeries](https://hipparis.com/gluten-free-paris-part-1-paris-best-gluten-free-bakeries): Paris gluten-free bakery guide: Chambelland, Helmut Newcake & more
- [The Parisian Kitchen Cooking Class and Market Tour](https://hipparis.com/the-parisian-kitchen-market-tour-and-cooking-class): Bénédicte's Parisian Kitchen: market tour & cooking class on rue de Lévis
- [Philippe Starck's Ma Cocotte: A Perfect Sunday Lunch Inside the Paris Flea Market](https://hipparis.com/philippe-starcks-ma-cocotte-a-perfect-sunday-lunch-inside-the-paris-flea-market): Philippe Starck-designed Ma Cocotte restaurant at Paul Bert flea market
- [Le Galopin: Fresh, Friendly Dining by Paris' Trendy Place Sainte Marthe](https://hipparis.com/le-galopin-fresh-friendly-dining-by-paris-trendy-canal-st-martin): Le Galopin by Top Chef's Romain Tischenko at Place Sainte Marthe
- [Fraîche: A Summer Must for Light French Fare Along the Canal St-Martin](https://hipparis.com/fraiche-a-summer-must-for-light-french-fare-along-the-canal-st-martin): Fraîche bistrot: seasonal French fare by Canal St-Martin from Top Chef grad
- [Les Choupettes de ChouChou: Organic Puff Pastry and Chantilly Cream in Montmartre](https://hipparis.com/les-choupettes-de-chouchou-organic-puff-pastry-and-chantilly-cream-in-montmartre): Montmartre pastry shop specializing in organic chouquettes with cream
- [Our Favorite Bistro Cookbooks, Part 2](https://hipparis.com/our-favorite-bistro-cookbooks-part-2): Curated French bistro cookbook recommendations from HiP Paris team

- [Empreintes: A New Concept Store Dedicated to French Craftsmanship](https://hipparis.com/empreintes-a-new-concept-store-dedicated-to-french-craftsmanship): Empreintes: Haut Marais concept store by Ateliers d'Art de France
- [5 Top French Menswear Brands | Men's Ties & More](https://hipparis.com/our-5-favorite-french-menswear-brands): Top 5 French menswear brands featuring Le Colonel Moutarde & accessories
